meta.title: In Spring — Set 4
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Fill-in and sentence practice quiz for 'In Spring'.

questions.question: You can walk in the woods and spy flowers hiding behind _______.
questions.explanation: The text states: 'You can walk in the woods and spy flowers hiding behind trees.'

questions.question: In spring, you can run outside after dinner without a coat.
questions.explanation: True. The days are warmer and longer, so you do not need a coat after dinner.

questions.question: In spring, days get _______.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'In spring, days get warmer.'

questions.question: You can wear boots and splash through deep, freezing snow.
questions.explanation: False. You wear boots and splash through 'puddles' of water on the ground.

questions.question: Why is spring the best _______? Just ask me!
questions.explanation: Spring is one of the four periods of the year, so it is a 'season.'

questions.question: You can feel the sun's _______ on your neck in spring.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'You can feel the sun’s warmth on your neck.'

questions.question: In spring, you can feel breezes blow _______.
questions.explanation: The text says breezes blow 'hints of hotter days,' showing that summer is coming.

questions.question: Sort these actions from the story based on who does them:
questions.explanation: People run outside, walk in the woods, and wear boots. Squirrels dart around, and plants grow again.

questions.question: 'Melting ice' in spring means the ice is freezing more.
questions.explanation: False. 'Melting' means changing from solid ice to liquid water as the temperature warms.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe a walk in spring:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'You can walk in the woods.' This is a fun spring activity.

questions.question: In spring, plants start _______ again after the winter cold.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'plants start growing again' in spring.

questions.question: You can watch squirrels _______ around in the yard.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'You can watch squirrels dart around.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe breezes blowing:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'You can feel breezes blow.' Breezes are gentle winds.

questions.question: Fawns struggle to walk on their young legs in spring.
questions.explanation: True. The text tells us: 'You can see fawns struggling to walk on their young legs.'

questions.question: Spring connects the cold of winter with the _______.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'It links the cold of winter with the heat of summer.'
